name: Kawasaki Nana
source:
A cute housewife. She's a friend of Chisato's. 
She's married to her husband by arrangement, and their sex life is far from what it should be. 
She tends to be passive.

[from [url=http://www.timsvault.com/pcgames_h/hitozuma.txt]a walkthrough by Eko Raharjo[/url]]
